title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The exhaustive when lens leads somewhere
summary: A when that covers every branch showed a lens with no command at all, which VS Code does not reliably draw. It now opens the sealed type it covers.

highlights.title: Covered branches, and a way to the type
highlights.description: Clicking the check mark on an exhaustive when opens the sealed class or enum it covers, which is the declaration you want to read next.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The lens on an exhaustive when carries a real command. Being the common case for this check, it was also the lens most at risk of not being drawn: an empty command is what made the drawable preview lens vanish once.
No lens in the extension relies on an empty command any more, and a test holds that for both branches of this provider.
